repeat.decoding: Deterministic conditional token scoring; no sampled generation.

pairwise.label_source: Derived support ordering from human hallucination spans: zero spans versus at least one. Not a human-preference benchmark.

sentence_units.interpretation: Original human spans projected by character overlap onto deterministic sentence units. Not atomic-claim annotations or span-level localization. Threshold selected for response detection.

configuration: qwen17/rubric for perturbations and uncached repeatability; Qwen3-1.7B A/B prompt for pairwise; nli-base/claims for sentence units
perturbation_scope: Evidence-line reversal can leave single-line JSON unchanged. Rates among changed inputs are reported separately; unchanged inputs reuse identical cached predictions.
